responsibility: Contains the core rs6000 machine-description patterns for AltiVec and related vector instructions. It defines Altivec-specific UNSPEC codes, mode iterators, move/load/store patterns, arithmetic, compare, permute, pack/unpack, conversion, BCD/vector extensions, expanders, and peepholes, forming the backend RTL instruction selection layer that lowers vector operations and builtins to PowerPC vector ISA encodings.
same_name_distinction: This is the backend machine-description half of the altivec pair: it defines UNSPEC codes, iterators, and RTL patterns for AltiVec instructions, whereas altivec.h is the front-facing C/C++ header exposing the vec_* interface.
